title: Flocked CGI
description: Rendu 3D haut de gamme caractérisé par un flocage dense et uniforme et des textures feutrées appliquées à des formes géométriques arrondies. Des couleurs hyper-vibrantes, un éclairage global doux et une faible profondeur de champ créent une esthétique tactile de jouet de créateur.
description_en: High-end 3D rendering characterized by dense, uniform flocking and felt-like textures applied to rounded geometric forms. Hyper-vibrant colors, soft global illumination, and shallow depth of field create a tactile, premium designer-toy aesthetic.
description_fr: Rendu 3D haut de gamme caractérisé par un flocage dense et uniforme et des textures feutrées appliquées à des formes géométriques arrondies. Des couleurs hyper-vibrantes, un éclairage global doux et une faible profondeur de champ créent une esthétique tactile de jouet de créateur.
prompt: High-end 3D CGI rendering featuring a tactile, premium designer-toy aesthetic defined by dense flocking simulation and fuzzy felt textures. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, full bleed to all four corners. The physical materiality consists entirely of matte plush, dense micro-fibers, and soft fleece, giving the entire composition a cohesive soft-sculpture quality. Color grading is hyper-vibrant and punchy, utilizing {{primary_color}} as the dominant hue, brilliantly highlighted by {{accent_color}}, and grounded by {{secondary_color}} in the shadows and supporting elements. Lighting mimics a professional macro studio setup: soft global illumination, a large diffused softbox key light, gentle ambient fill, and crisp rim lighting that catches the micro-fibers along the smoothly rounded silhouettes. Shadows are soft-edged and ambient, completely avoiding harsh contrast. Forms are distinctly stylized, chunky, and smoothly beveled, lacking any sharp geometric angles. Spatial dynamics rely heavily on a pronounced shallow depth of field, establishing a macro-photography scale with creamy bokeh that heavily blurs distant background elements and extreme foreground objects. Edges are organically softened by the fuzzy, flocked geometry rather than hard vector lines or digital strokes. The atmosphere is exceptionally polished, playful, and physically inviting, reminiscent of high-end cinematic trailers for mobile gaming or meticulously fabricated stop-motion puppet worlds. Rendered with volumetric precision, subsurface scattering on secondary matte materials, and pristine anti-aliasing.

video.motion: Movements should exhibit smooth, bouncy, soft-body physics with exaggerated, playful easing.
video.camera: Utilize a macro lens aesthetic with slow, sweeping dolly movements or subtle orbits to emphasize the shallow depth of field.
video.temporal_texture: The dense flocking and micro-fiber textures must remain temporally locked to the geometry without jittering, crawling, or sparkling.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, rigid mechanical movements, sharp camera cuts, and flickering fur simulations.
